title: Recover representable covariance when the mean reduction overflows
observation: A constant fictional column of 1e308 returns is rejected even though its covariance is exactly zero; another finite changing column is lost with it.
cause: NumPy covariance can overflow while summing a column to form its mean before centering.
severity: incorrect arithmetic, state or evidence admission on valid/ambiguous boundary inputs
implemented_change: On the non-finite covariance path only, use reference-centered normalized arithmetic and restore units. Preserve original normal-scale calculations and existing genuine overflow/underflow rejection.
predicted_consequence: New constructed regressions fail on the recorded parent and pass after the repair while the existing bounded suite passes.
